name: Crimson flesh
mutagen_message: A second pulse beats beneath your skin. You accepted Slan’s gift; the change has only begun.

name: Folded space
mutagen_message: Your body feels light and frail; nearby distances seem uncertain.

name: Borrowed faces
mutagen_message: Other people’s expressions linger in your thoughts. Your body loses some of its strength.

name: Cinder rot
mutagen_message: Your pulse slows. A bitter smell follows each breath; ordinary movement becomes slower.

name: Black wings
mutagen_message: Pressure gathers beneath your shoulder blades. Your reserves of stamina diminish.

name: Pliant flesh
mutagen_message: Your steps become heavier. Movement is 10 points slower, throughout the transformation.

name: Hunting beast
mutagen_message: Your muscles strain against a slower recovery. Stamina regeneration is reduced by 10%, throughout the transformation.

name: Winged hunter
mutagen_message: Your skin grows thin and sensitive. Take 15% more bash, cut and stab damage, throughout the transformation.

name: Cinder carapace
mutagen_message: A hot hunger settles into your body. Burn 35% more calories and recover stamina 15% more slowly, throughout the transformation.

name: Servant of the Count
mutagen_message: Your altered flesh slows you throughout the transformation. The Count shelters his own, but only while the pact holds. Your strength will never equal his.

name: Beast of the Black Dogs
mutagen_message: Stamina returns more slowly, and beast hands hinder precise work. Wyald’s favor feeds your strongest impulse; you remain his lesser fighter.

name: Child of the false valley
mutagen_message: Words become awkward clicks, persuasion falters and crafting slows. Your body is fragile. You can still choose, speak and act; Rosine has not made you a mindless creature.

name: Carapace vassal
mutagen_message: Your heavy body moves more slowly and needs more food, throughout the transformation. You serve Grunbeld; this lesser shell will never grow into his dragon.
